description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the OAuthClientDao class, which manages OAuth client entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup procedures, tests for CRUD operations, and filtering functionalities related to OAuth clients.

classes.name: OAuthClientDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing OAuthClientDao operations like save, retrieve, filter, and delete OAuth clients within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, including OAuthClientDao instance and test data population.

methods.name: testSaveOAuthClient
methods.description: Tests the creation and persistence of a new OAuthClient entity.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of OAuth clients with filtering.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Checks counting of OAuth clients matching specific filter criteria.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an OAuthClient by its ID, including handling of non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an OAuthClient using its client ID, including invalid cases.

methods.name: testDeleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Verifies the deletion of OAuth clients by IDs and confirms the remaining entities.
